name: Shede Spirits Co., Ltd.
summary: Shede Spirits Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, produces, and sells of liquor products in China. It engages in the production and sale of glass products; wholesale and retail of alcoholic beverages and their packaging materials; grain purchase and sale; material procurement and sale; and commercial trade. The company is also involved in domestic tourism; tourism scenic area development; exhibition and display services; sales of pre-packaged food; wine distribution, food sales, online food sales, food import and export, brand management, marketing planning, and internet sales; and inspection and testing services; and road freight transport, general cargo warehousing services…
